title: Relabeling machine states
statement: Given a nondeterministic Turing machine with state set $S$ and an equivalence $e:S\simeq S'$, relabel its states using $e$: the new initial state is the image of the old initial state, and each transition is obtained by translating its input state back along $e$ and its successor state forward along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with state set $S$
